name: Apple Automator
description: Apple Automator is a macOS automation app for combining built-in actions, recorded interactions and scripts into reusable workflows and Quick Actions.
agentUseSummary: Apple Automator is visible as a local-runtime security preview. Relay will not execute a mutable workflow until a Mac-local bridge can inspect and bind its exact content, reject interactive execution and enforce device-local authority boundaries.

capabilities.label: Run approved local workflows
capabilities.description: After local bridge hardening, run only an inspected, version-bound and non-interactive workflow on its approved Mac.

blocked.label: Run an Automator workflow from Railway
blocked.description: Automator executes workflows on a Mac; Relay will not invent a cloud API or route device-local authority through Railway.

blocked.label: Trust a mutable workflow path or name
blocked.description: A saved workflow can be edited after selection, so its path or display name is not an immutable authority boundary.

blocked.label: Run unreviewed scripts or recorded actions
blocked.description: Automator workflows can contain shell commands, AppleScript, JavaScript and recorded UI interactions with broad local effects.

blocked.label: Run workflows that prompt at execution time
blocked.description: Automator actions can show runtime choices, which cannot be safely treated as unattended agent execution.

blocked.label: Run actions before local bridge hardening
blocked.description: No discover, inspect, import or run action is callable until a local bridge enforces content hashing, action inventory, input/output bounds, non-interactive execution, auditing and revocation.

approvalProfiles.label: Local bridge review required
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and execution remain unavailable until Relay can bind immutable workflow content and constrain local actions, scripts, prompts and data flow.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tool is callable until a hardened Mac-local bridge can inspect, bind and audit approved Automator workflow content.
No Hermes tool is callable until a hardened Mac-local bridge can inspect, bind and audit approved Automator workflow content.

providerSetup.blocker: Automator workflows are mutable local programs that can include recorded UI actions, shell commands, AppleScript, JavaScript and runtime prompts with device authority.
providerSetup.nextAction: Implement a Mac-local bridge that inventories every action, hashes the exact workflow content and device binding, rejects prompts and unknown or recorded actions, bounds input/output and runtime, audits locally, detects drift and revokes changed workflows.

evidence.supports: Apple documents workflow types, action composition, recorded actions and Quick Actions with app, input and output settings.
Apple documents sequential local action execution, action logs, errors and optional runtime settings dialogs.
Apple documents embedding shell commands, AppleScript and JavaScript in Automator workflows and controlling Automator with scripts.
Apple describes Automator as a Mac-local workflow application and documents migration of workflows into Shortcuts.
